assumptions.payoffs: linear payoffs only — near-the-money binary/digital payoffs make a tiny move decisive, so their capacity on these fixings is ≈ zero
assumptions.attacker: single-party worst case: one attacker holds the entire opposing side of the open interest
assumptions.costs: fee-burn floors (wash fraction × venue fee); inventory and price risk excluded, so true attack cost is higher
assumptions.deltaCap: center capture is unbounded; the capture bound assumes a dispute layer capping the credible print at Δcap = 5%
assumptions.hedging: independent ceiling: hedgeable OI ≈ the underlying's daily $ volume — capacity beyond what spot absorbs is unusable
